title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: A magical story about a mysterious library between life and death. Each book inside shows a different version of life choices. Nora explores the paths she could have taken in life. The novel mixes fantasy, regret, and hope beautifully. It inspires readers to value the life they already have.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: An epic science fiction novel set on the desert planet Arrakis. The story revolves around politics, survival, and power struggles. Spice, the most valuable substance in the universe, controls everything. Paul Atreides faces challenges that will shape the future of humanity. The book is famous for its deep world-building and imagination.

title: The Pragmatic
author: David Thomas
description: A classic guide for software developers and programmers. It teaches practical ways to write cleaner and smarter code. The book focuses on productivity, problem solving, and coding habits. Developers learn how to think critically while building software. It remains one of the most recommended tech books worldwide.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: This book explains complex ideas about the universe in simple language. Stephen Hawking discusses black holes, space, and time. Readers discover theories about the Big Bang and the cosmos. The book combines science with fascinating philosophical questions. It is considered one of the greatest science books ever written.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A must-read handbook for software developers and engineers. The book teaches how to write readable and maintainable code. It focuses on coding standards, refactoring, and best practices. Real examples help programmers improve their development skills. It is widely respected in the software engineering community.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A groundbreaking book about evolution and genetics. Richard Dawkins explains evolution from the perspective of genes. The concept of memes was introduced through this book. It challenges traditional ways of understanding natural selection. The book remains highly influential in biology and science.

author: George Orwell
description: A famous dystopian novel about surveillance and dictatorship. The story follows Winston Smith in a controlled society. Big Brother constantly watches and controls every citizen. Themes of freedom, truth, and rebellion are deeply explored. The novel remains highly relevant in the modern world.

title: You Don't Know JS
author: Kyle Simpson
description: An advanced guide to understanding JavaScript deeply. The book explains core concepts often ignored by developers. Topics include scope, closures, and asynchronous programming. Readers gain strong knowledge of how JavaScript actually works. It is highly recommended for frontend and backend developers.

title: The Gene: An Intimate History
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
description: This book explores the history and science of genetics. It explains discoveries from Mendel to modern gene editing. The author connects science with human stories and ethics. Readers learn about DNA, heredity, and future possibilities. It is both educational and emotionally engaging.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A thrilling science fiction adventure set in deep space. An astronaut wakes up alone without remembering his mission. He must solve scientific mysteries to save humanity from extinction. The story combines humor, suspense, and emotional moments. It is praised for its creativity and scientific accuracy.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: A detailed guide to modern data systems and databases. The book explains scalability, reliability, and distributed systems clearly. Developers learn about data processing and system architecture. Real-world examples help readers understand complex engineering concepts. It is one of the best books for backend engineers.

title: The Body: A Guide for Occupants
author: Bill Bryson
description: A fascinating exploration of the human body and its systems. Bill Bryson explains biology in a fun and simple style. Readers discover how organs and cells work together. The book includes surprising facts about health and medicine. It makes science enjoyable and easy to understand.
